artworks.title: Sebastian Le Clerc
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper part of the body, from the chest upwards. The person, identified as Seb. Le Clerc, is positioned in a three-quarter view, looking slightly to the side. He has curly hair that cascades over his shoulders, framing his face. His facial features include a prominent nose and a neutral expression. He is wearing a dark garment with elaborate detailing, along with a white collar. The portrait is set within an oval frame, and below it is a decorative crest or emblem. The background consists of a textured pattern, contrasting with the smooth oval frame around the figure.

artworks.title: Pallas Athene in the Form of a Bird Leaving Nestor and Telemachus
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and brown washes over graphite, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. Phillips in memory of Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring an owl and a group of individuals. The drawing depicts a classical architectural setting with grand, towering columns and an archway in the background. In the foreground, a group of figures are portrayed in dramatic poses. One figure is sitting on a chair, reaching upwards while another kneels nearby. Two other figures are gesturing toward the owl, and a small pedestal table with vases is visible. The use of chiaroscuro and fine lines outlines the detailed textures of clothing and architectural elements, giving the scene a somber and majestic atmosphere.

artworks.title: An Ancient Sacrifice
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. Phillips in memory of Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial scene in a grand architectural setting. The drawing depicts an interior with large, ornate columns reminiscent of classical Roman or Greek architecture. The ceiling has intricate designs and a circular arrangement of decorative panels. In the foreground and mid-ground, there is a gathering around an altar or pedestal, upon which a flame burns. Several figures, robed in flowing garments, are gathered around this central point, possibly in the midst of a ritual involving offerings. The figures are holding various objects, including what looks to be a dish. The space feels grand and solemn, with an emphasis on tradition and ritual. The shading and linework suggest careful attention to detail and capture the grandeur of both the figures and the architecture surrounding them.

artworks.title: Mythological Composition with Chronos and Harpies [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures in a dynamic scene. The central figure holds a tall staff with an expressive stance. Wing-like shapes are behind the central figure. Below, smaller figures resembling cherubs or similar beings with wings are present. To the left, another figure is in a seated or reclining position. Soft, flowing lines and a reddish hue give the drawing a classical and elegant feel. The scene captures an energetic moment in time.

artworks.title: Study of Two Putti and a Draped Arm [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a pencil sketch focusing on two human figures, showing only their hands and part of an arm. On the left, a hand is extended with gracefully curved fingers. This hand appears to be emerging from flowing fabric. On the right, an arm is visible, bent at the elbow, with a hand resting on the upper arm. The lines are bold, capturing the anatomy of the hand with shading for volume and texture. There are no facial features or hair visible. The background is an aged paper surface with faint lines and discoloration.

artworks.title: The Storm
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on tan wove paper mounted to board
artworks.dimensions: overall: 33 x 46 cm (13 x 18 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hollis Taggart Galleries, Inc.
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a harbor scene with boats and figures. The horizon is near the top of the image, with clouds and hints of buildings and a lighthouse. The brushstrokes are bold and expressive, creating movement in the sails and water. The color palette is monochromatic, with black and brown tones on light brown paper. Closest are boats with figures, adding life to the scene. In the distance, larger ships and masts are softly shaded.

artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a wooden rowboat on a calm body of water. Two individuals are in the boat - one adjusting fishing nets at the left end, and the other holding an oar on the right. The horizon is high, with reeds and trees along the water's edge. The photo is in black and white, creating a classic and timeless ambiance with smooth transitions between shadows and highlights. The grayscale tones emphasize the tranquility of the scene, with reflections of the boat and people mirrored on the water's surface.

artworks.title: A Broadman's Cottage
artworks.artist: Peter Henry Emerson and T.F. Goodall

artworks.description: The image shows a waterside scene captured from a low angle, slightly elevated above the water. The horizon consists of a grassy and reed-filled bank with trees and a thatched-roof cottage in the background. The style is realistic in black and white, with detailed textures in the water, reeds, and trees. A person is seen in a small boat near the water's edge, navigating with a wooden pole. A larger sailboat is docked nearby, contributing to the tranquility of the setting. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and black and soft contrasts to highlight details in reflections on the water and sky. The sky is partly cloudy, diffusing light across the scene.

artworks.title: A Sailing Match at Horning
artworks.dimensions:

artworks.description: The image shows a river with sailboats gliding through the calm water. Lush, tree-lined banks merge with the horizon in the distance. The sailboats have billowing sails and are spread out across the water. The closest sailboat is on the right with figures on board. Other boats are further away, creating depth. The sky is overcast with a sepia tone. The color palette is subdued, giving a vintage quality. Soft, diffused clouds complement the tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.description: The image shows a person standing on the bank of a narrow waterway, looking towards two sailboats gliding on calm water. In the background, there is a cluster of houses suggesting a village, with trees interspersed. The larger sailboat fills the left side of the image, with another boat seen in the distance. The reflection of the sails is mirrored in the water, conveying stillness. The image is in black and white, emphasizing shades of grey for a vintage atmosphere focused on form and light.

artworks.description: The image shows two men standing in shallow water next to a small wooden boat, handling fishing nets. The background features distant trees, a cloudy sky, and two small structures or boats on the horizon. The overall color scheme is muted in sepia tones, giving the image a vintage appearance. The contrast between the dark clothing of the men and the lighter tones of the water and sky, with soft lighting, creates a serene and industrious atmosphere.

artworks.description: The image shows a black and white scene captured from an elevated angle. In the scene, two individuals are in a wooden rowboat. One person is reaching out to pluck a water lily from the water, while the other is guiding the boat with an oar. Tall reeds line the edges of the water, and in the distance, there is a forested area. The image has a soft, diffuse quality.

artworks.description: This is a photograph of individuals standing in a marshy landscape with guns. The scene captures a group of people holding rifles while standing in shallow water, surrounded by a wetland. The water reflects the figures and the sky. In the background, there are a few trees and a cloudy sky. The individuals are dressed in appropriate clothing for the wetland, with one accompanied by a dog. The photograph portrays a sense of calm and expectation in the natural setting.

artworks.description: The image shows a serene scene with a wide expanse of water on the right side. A small sailboat with three people is seen gliding through the calm surface. A trio of rustic wooden buildings stand to the left, close to the water's edge, with wisps of smoke rising from a chimney. Delicate, leafless trees fade into the background. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by soft grays and muted tones, suggesting a misty or overcast day.

In the background, there are trees, buildings, and a dark-roofed structure. The scene is in black and white, with trees on the left and clouds in the sky. The atmosphere is quiet and slightly misty.

A fence made of bundled material stretches diagonally towards leafless trees, with marshland extending into the distance under a cloudy sky. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the contrasts in the scene.

artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil scene captured from a low vantage point near the water's edge. The water is speckled with leaves and lily pads, reflecting the sky's various shades of gray. The horizon is placed high in the frame, where a line of distant trees meets the hazy sky. A small boat with a person kneeling in it is positioned near the reeds on the right-hand side. Large trees with full canopies dominate the left side, while the overall color palette is monochromatic, using a range of grays.

artworks.description: The image is a black and white photograph of a rural waterway scene. In the foreground, a man in a small boat navigates through calm waters with a pole. In the background, another boat is visible, carrying harvested reeds or hay with another person using a pole. On the left, vegetation hangs over the water from the bank. The horizon is low, and there are clouds scattered in the sky. The scene is serene and timeless, with various shades of grey conveying a subdued tone.

artworks.title: Poling the Marsh Hay

She holds a forked tool and is surrounded by hay on a grassy bank next to a narrow waterway. In the background, two other figures are also working. The scene has tall grass, distant trees, and an overcast sky.

artworks.title: Setting Up the Bow-Net
artworks.dimensions:

artworks.description: The image shows two men near water, setting up or inspecting a large fishing net. Both men are depicted from head to knees. The man on the left is bent forward slightly, while the man on the right is in a semi-squatting position, both holding onto the net. The man on the left has facial hair, a mustache, and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a dark-colored jacket, and light-colored trousers. The man on the right has facial hair and is wearing a similar hat, a dark vest over a lighter shirt, and darker trousers. The background consists of tall grasses and bushes, with trees further back, under a bright sky with some clouds.
